description: This file defines the `AnalysisSkillRepository` class, which handles database operations related to the 'analysis_skills' junction table, including creating records and listing skills by analysis.

classes.name: AnalysisSkillRepository
classes.description: Repository class providing CRUD operations for the analysis_skills junction table, including methods to create records and list skills associated with a particular analysis.

methods.name: int create(self, analysis_id: UUID, skill_id: int, confidence: float | None)
methods.description: Asynchronously inserts a new record into the analysis_skills table with analysis_id, skill_id, and optional confidence score, returning the inserted record's id.

methods.name: List[dict] list_by_analysis(self, analysis_id: UUID)
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a list of skills associated with a given analysis_id, including skill name and type, ordered by confidence and skill name.

ctags.name: create
ctags.pattern: /^    async def create(self, analysis_id: UUID, skill_id: int, confidence: float | None) -> int:$/
ctags.signature: (self, analysis_id: UUID, skill_id: int, confidence: float | None)

ctags.name: list_by_analysis
ctags.pattern: /^    async def list_by_analysis(self, analysis_id: UUID) -> List[dict]:$/
